Nora (Sales): FYI AcmeCorp asked for final PO + signed MSA today. They're pushing a 60-day termination and an SLA bump for the POC. Can Legal/Finance advise?
Ethan (Legal): quick read: 60-day term is negotiable but increases risk. propose 45-day compromise. SLA bump ok if timeboxed in a POC addendum with capped credits.
Priya (Solutions): Acme wants two Dedicated nodes for 30->45 days and no charges for POC usage. We can allocate nodes, but need a credit memo SKU to zero invoice. Also they'll need onboarding ops support.
Marco (Finance): Net60 okay if RevOps approves. For non-billable POC we need an orderform that shows items + negative trial credit. RevOps can countersign up to $50k.
ops-bot: uploaded file sources/docs/Acme/acme_poc_sow_v1.pdf
Nora (Sales): can Legal prepare a short counter with tracked changes and mark the SLA change as pilot-only? Also signal required approval thresholds for signature routing.
Ethan (Legal): will draft counter + POC addendum and flag termination >45 days as non-starter. I'll upload in ~2 hours.
Priya (Solutions): I'll attach the POC success criteria and an ops runbook. Need Eng to confirm subprocessors (monitoring).
Marco (Finance): once draft is in, I'll create provisional orderform including a line: "Trial credit: -$40,000". Send final SKU list.
Nora (Sales): sending SKU + billing contact now. scheduling 10am PT alignment call with Acme to close the POC scoping.
Ethan (Legal): ack, I'll join call to accelerate countersignature.
Nora (Sales): goal: get POC addendum signed by EOD Fri so Dedicated nodes can be provisioned next week.
